run.change_description:
refactor: resolve SonarQube findings

- Reduce cognitive complexity in runProviderBackups, displayStartupConfig,
  checkProvider, Run and checkProvidersDefined by extracting focused
  helpers; behaviour and log output unchanged.
- Extract duplicated backup status titles into constants with a shared
  backupStatusTitle helper (notify.go).
- Remove TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup2 (identical duplicate of
  TestPublicGitLabRepositoryBackup) and simplify
  TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup with assertion helpers.
- Dockerfile: merge consecutive RUN instructions, sort apk packages,
  quote the TAG variable in the download URL.

summary.intent: Resolve 13 SonarQube findings (complexity, duplicated literals, duplicate test, Dockerfile style) with behaviour and log output unchanged.
summary.issue_fit: Met — no issue exists; against the supplied PR text every stated outcome is implemented and the unchanged-output claim held under trace.
summary.coverage: All four files and the full merge-base diff reviewed; build, vet and `go test ./internal/` pass offline at the head; Dockerfile not built (no Docker).
check_details: Reviewer ran `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/` and `go test ./internal/ -count=1` at 136a4850df9aec8c: all pass (live provider tests skip without credentials).
Supplied PR-body claims about local build, lint and test results were not reused as evidence; golangci-lint was not run and the Dockerfile could not be built.

observations.fact: The `Organistations` typo the earlier review flagged exists verbatim at the merge-base in three log lines and is now emitted from one helper, matching the PR's promise that log output is unchanged.
The doubled `resetBackups()` call per loop iteration in `TestGiteaOrgsRepositoryBackup` is carried over from the merge-base, where it was already called in each case and after the switch.
The three backup status title strings are byte-identical at the merge-base and the head, including the leading U+FE0F sequences.
observations.evidence: `internal/notify.go:23-25`, xxd comparison of merge-base and head.
